Question
========
According to the 68-95-99.7 rule, what can we say about a person whose score is more than 2 standard deviations above the mean?


Answerlist
----------

* Their score is unusual and higher than most.

* Their score is very common.

* Their score is likely below average.

* Their score is within the middle 68% of the distribution.
